interface.longDescription: Plan, operate, evaluate, and review project-scoped Nexus Starship Guardians workflows. Supports Intelligence Fabric strategy planning, Guardian Intelligence Lab fixed-corpus evaluation, governed Guardian Benchmark Vault learning from verified regressions, live mission classification, capability mapping, permission-safe Guardian routing, project onboarding, bounded Guardian runs through the compatible REST v1 API, explicit approval review, integration readiness checks, and evidence-first verification. The package does not bundle a hosted model, credentials, or unrestricted tool permissions.
capabilities: Plan missions with explicit strategy, uncertainty, adversarial checks, capabilities, and tool requirements
Evaluate baseline and candidate Guardian strategies against fingerprinted fixed corpora
Grow future benchmark snapshots through evidence-linked regression candidates and explicit review
Plan isolated Nexus projects and Guardian permissions
Run and inspect authorized Guardian tasks
Assess Lucio, Ember, Nexus Code, Railway, and Supabase integration readiness
Audit verification, tenant isolation, and production readiness
defaultPrompt: Build an Intelligence Fabric plan for this mission and show strategy, uncertainty, evidence, and adversarial checks.
Compare a baseline and candidate using the Guardian Intelligence Lab fixed corpus and show the promotion evidence.
Show how this verified regression would enter the Guardian Benchmark Vault and what review is required before freezing a new snapshot.
Inspect my Nexus run and explain any pending approvals.
Review whether this Nexus integration has enough evidence for release.
